subject: Do RStudio Addins work on RStudio Server?

messages.author: 1667ac6354bdba89
messages.subject: Do RStudio Addins work on RStudio Server?
parts:
Hi there,

I have an RStudio Addin that works great in RStudio, but when I run it on RStudio Server it flashes up loading, but then disappears to blank.  The Shiny session is still running, but I need to cancel it.

This happens with mine and other Shiny Addins such as the colorpicker of shinyjs()

I ask in this Shiny forum as the gadgets are mini Shiny apps, but let me know if its better placed somewhere else.

Yours sincerely,
Mark

messages.subject: Re: Do RStudio Addins work on RStudio Server?
parts:
Other perhaps useful info: I do a proxyPass in Apache for RStudio server for nice URLs.

When I did the same for Shiny Server I got issues with websockets:

I needed a line like this in my Apache config:

ProxyPassMatch ^/reports/(.+)/websocket ws://localhost:3838/$1/websocket

I'm not sure what the equivalent would be for the RStudio server version of Shiny its running.
